summary.content:
Today's selection covers 100 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 67 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Pope Leo calls for the disarmament of AI: ‘Machines are tools, not persons’
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Binance Suspends Withdrawals After Crypto Hackers Steal $6.3 Billion
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, Dark Reading, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 57 articles published in the last 24 hours
